---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a substantive change to the framework or its governance
title: '[Proposal] '
---

## Status
Draft. No vote is open. Facilitator, reviewed version, and dates: pending.

## Proposed change
What exact wording or mechanism should change? Which files and sections are affected?

## Purpose and connections
Which human outcome does this serve? How does it affect security, freedom, ownership, power, and the transition?

## Evidence and uncertainty
Sources, passages, dates, applicable jurisdictions, counterevidence, and unresolved claims.

## Costs and affected people
Who pays, who works, who benefits, who bears risks, and what alternatives are displaced?

## Alternatives and failure conditions
Include the current approach, other plausible options, reversibility, and what would change your conclusion.

## Interests and authorship
Relevant affiliations, interests, and AI assistance, if any. Do not include private information.

## Requested next step
Discussion, evidence review, draft editing, or consideration for a later vote?

## Integration and rights
Files requiring coordinated updates. Confirm that proposed original text may be included in this public repository with attribution, or identify applicable permission terms. A future general project license remains unresolved.
